name: dev-team
description: Faithful port of bdfinst/agentic-dev-team's dev-team plugin (v10.20.0) to Oh-My-Pi: orchestrator + 45 specialist/critic agents, 93 skills including /ship, a 58-file knowledge corpus, and upstream's 38 Python hook invocations run unmodified through a protocol bridge. Agent prompts, skill bodies and every Python file are byte-for-byte upstream; only the Claude Code -> OMP format conversion is applied. Requires python3.
